en: "What a terrible thing...{w}Lord Branet..."{w}
Having refused to let go to the very end, Branet was swallowed alive into the Abyss together with Eril...{w}
note: shin'en (lit. 'profound', used here for 'abyss') rendered 'the Abyss', capitalised because the Wraith names it 'the great Abyss, Apasha' (3120/3124). Slice 045 (3095, 3109) uses the same word.

en: "So that... was the Abyss..."{w}

"That is right, priestess.{w}The souls you could not save are, in time, drawn into that place."{w}{p}"Unlike the other Wraiths, I have no interest in their petty game of playing king of the evil spirits."{w}{p}"My wish is to free the souls that have been taken into the great Abyss, Apasha."{w}{p}"And then to destroy the path of souls laid down by the gods, and bring about a new order of souls."{w}{p}"I cannot allow any more deeds that disturb the peaceful sleep of the dead."{w}
note: purisutesu = 'priestess' (glossary note: the Wraith's address for Sigret). kami unmarked for number: 'the gods', as slice 011. Whose deeds disturb the dead is not stated; kept impersonal.

en: "If you truly wish to bring salvation to the spirits of the dead, then go after Apasha, the Abyss."{w}{p}"I, too, am investigating the Gate of the Underworld and Apasha, together with the Grand Chancellor.{w}If fate allows, we shall meet again... Farewell."{w}
note: omae = Sigret (the Wraith has just addressed her as priestess; her reaction 3122/3126). Confirms slice 011 (3225) reading 'if I truly want to save those souls, I should go after Apasha'. Daishousho = 'the Grand Chancellor' (new term; recurs in slice 031 and as a room name in slice 065).

en: "Wait, Wraith! ...Please, wait...{w}Rattling off all these things I can't make sense of...{w}What was that just now... What is that supposed to mean!!"{w}

"I'm sorry... I'm just a little confused...{w}The one thing I did understand... is that if things stay as they are, there will be more and more unhappy souls..."{w}{p}"I'm going to go cool my head a little...{w}If you're heading back, go on ahead without me..."{w}
note: Spoken to the party (modoru nara, saki ni itte).

en: You found a strawberry frozen in ice.{w}

[Key Item]
You obtained the Ice Strawberry!{w}
note: Kouri Ichigo = 'Ice Strawberry' (new key item name).

en: ...Or so you thought, but someone snatched it away!!{w}
Snow Rabbit

"Heh heh~, you slowpoke, kyu~!{w}The Ice Strawberry is mine!
If that bugs you, try and catch me, kyu~!!"{w}
note: Verbal tic -kkyu rendered as a tagged 'kyu'. Snow Rabbit's gender unknown ('boku' only); narration uses 'it'.

en: The Snow Rabbit hid in the snow!{w}
"N-not yet, kyu!{w}My hide-and-seek skills are way better than this, kyu! Hyaah!"{w}
"N-no way!?{w}Darn it, this time I'm getting away for sure, kyu!!{w}Hyah, hyah, hyaaah!!"{w}
"Kyu, kyuuuu...{w}I lose, kyu..."{w}

[Key Item]
You obtained the Ice Strawberry.{w}
"Hide-and-seek sure runs deep, kyu!{w}I shouldn't get cocky just because I'm a snow rabbit -- I'm going to practice for real, kyu!!"{w}
note: Read as the rabbit resolving to itself after losing, not advice to the party.

en: The Snow Rabbit went away.{w}
"Not there, kyu~{w}Dummy, dummyyy!!{w}DUUUUUUMMMMMMYYYYYYY!!"{w}
The Snow Rabbit's presence has vanished...{w}It seems it got away from you.{w}
Who will make the attempt??
note: Double question mark kept from the source.

en: Where will you search?
You plunged a hand into the snow!{w}
Mugyoo!?{w}
note: No quote brackets in the source; none added.

en: You caught it!{w}
You felt nothing there...{w}
North
East
South
West
There's a signpost buried in the snow.{w}

note: Sign box kept in the source's asterisk frame (same 49-char frame as the 'Dead End' sign); check centring in game.

en: "Pardon me... traveler...{w}Ah, you're awake. Thank goodness...{w}Pressing on through this blizzard is reckless beyond words."{w}{p}"If you head southwest from this hut, there is a place that will carry you outside, so please go home from there."{w}
note: tabi no okata: singular address kept ('traveler'); she later calls the party kono kata (2744).

en: "Pardon me... traveler...{w}You still haven't gone home?"{w}{p}"I am telling you this for your own good.{w}Please leave by way of the southwest.{w}You will heed my words, won't you?"{w}

"Pardon me... traveler...{w}Why do you not go home?{w}Do you have some business in Flotban?"{w}{p}"North of here lies Glacier Castle, where General Winter dwells.{w}It would be best not to go near it."{w}{p}"If you insist, then go out from the north side of this hut and head south through the cave, and you will find a device that stops the blizzard."{w}
note: Route wording kept close to the source ('from the north of this hut, head south through the cave').

en: You were taught how to work the switch that stops the blizzard.{w}
"Please go on without looking back.{w}...When spring comes, the snow will melt, too.{w}You must never come back here..."{w}
"The blizzard has stopped.{w}And yet, why do you keep coming back?"{w}{p}"For one who lives alone in this hut,{w}meeting someone like you lights a lamp in my heart. In other words..."{w}
Miyuki
"I... I, Miyuki...{w}...have come to love you so."{w}
note: koishiku omotte shimau: she cannot help longing for/loving the player.

en: "Yes...{w}I know it is a selfish wish.{w}And yet..."{w}{p}"If you would warm this body and heart of mine, chilled to the core, then as a token, please, take this blade..."{w}
Miyuki held out a short blade, icy cold and keenly gleaming.{w}
note: The blade is unnamed here (glossary: 'Miyuki' is also a sword name).

en: Accept it?
"..........{w}I knew it, all along.{w}But some feelings simply cannot be held back."{w}{p}"If we cannot be together, then I would rather...{w}Ah...{w}Please... forgive... me..."{w}
note: Refusal branch; she then attacks (2715).

en: You routed Miyuki.{w}
"..........{w}No... I can't kill you...{w}Uuh..."{w}{p}"Please, don't come here again...{w}Farewell..."{w}
"You will... accept it...{w}You will accept these feelings of mine...{w}Ah... Miyuki is so very happy..."{w}
note: Her third-person self-reference kept.

en: "Mother... forgive me...{w}Miyuki will be happy with this one..."{w}
note: kono hito: the player, gender unknown -> 'this one'.

en: Snow Spirit
"Miss Miyuki!!"{w}
note: ojousama -> 'Miss'; Miyuki-sama -> 'Lady Miyuki' (female established in glossary).

en: Abominable Snowman
note: Glossary form; 18 chars, over the ~16-char name-box guide. Check fit.

en: "Miss Miyukiiii!"{w}
note: Miyuki-han (dialect honorific) -> 'Miss', drawn out.

en: "Lady Miyuki!{w}We've finally found you!{w}Your father has been terribly worried!"{w}
"Word is he's brought ya a marriage offer, y'know."{w}
note: Subject = her father (General Winter, male per glossary) from the previous line. Rustic dialect given light colloquial English.

en: "I have already given my answer about the marriage offer.{w}I will go with no one but the one I have chosen in my heart."{w}
"No, no, you are the daughter of the lord of Glacier Castle.{w}Such selfishness will not be allowed. Come now, this way."{w}
"Stop it, you insolent wretch!!"{w}
What seem to be her attendants try to drag Miyuki away by force.{w}The attendants noticed you standing there, dumbfounded.{w}
"Hmm? Who're you lot?"{w}
"Miss, who are they?{w}Don't tell me... you've already found a sweetheart down in the village...?"{w}
note: sato = the human settlement below; 'the village'.

en: "Ngh... this person is...{w}..........{w}...just someone who got lost in the snow."{w}{p}"I only looked after them."{w}
"Then that's all right.{w}If ya had a sweetheart in the village, we'd hafta kill 'em.{w}Good thing, good thing."{w}
"You got lucky, you know. Not that Lady Miyuki would ever bother with the likes of you anyway.{w}Now, let's go, Lady Miyuki."{w}
"Headin' home now!"{w}
Miyuki lowered her eyes sadly and was taken away.{w}

There is a door sealed tight by snow and ice.
You can't see anything that looks like a keyhole.{w}
note: fubuki to koori: 'snow and ice' (lit. 'blizzard and ice').

en: You found something that looks like a switch.{w}However, you couldn't figure out how to operate it.{w}
You have already turned off the blizzard switch.{w}
Snowman Gatekeeper
note: Glossary form; 18 chars, over the ~16-char name-box guide. Check fit.

en: "Hey, hey, hey!{w}Now it's the fire alarm over there!?{w}Is there really a fire? Isn't the thing just broken?"{w}{p}"...And who are you?{w}We're in the middle of something, so come back later."{w}
"Hey, what's all the fuss?"{w}
Wolf Gatekeeper
"They say the fire alarm went off."{w}
"Well, that's a rare one...{w}...Whoa there!!"{w}
"This is Glacier Castle, where the great General Winter resides!"{w}
"Nobody gets through here!!"{w}
Yeti Gatekeeper
